# Morphing Panel > A compact control that expands into settings, workspace navigation, or an inline confirmation, with stable alignment and keyboard dismissal. Status: experimental. This file matches the installed `morphing-panel` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/morphing-panel.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/morphing-panel.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `collapsible` - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/morphing-panel-knobs`: `morphingPanelKnobs`, types `MorphingPanelKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/morphing-panel`: `MorphingPanelPositioner`, `MorphingPanel`, `MorphingPanelTrigger`, `MorphingPanelContent`, `MorphingPanelClose`, `MorphingPanelHeader`, `morphingPanelBodyPaddings`, `MorphingPanelBody`, `MorphingPanelFooter`, types `MorphingPanelDimensions`, `MorphingPanelAnchor`, `MorphingPanelProps`, `MorphingPanelTriggerProps`, `MorphingPanelContentProps`, `MorphingPanelPositionerProps`, `MorphingPanelPartProps`, `MorphingPanelCloseProps`, `MorphingPanelBodyPadding` ## Composition ### Expandable surface The surface stays in document flow. Content is scrollable; use Header, Body, and Footer to keep controls and actions visible. Escape closes the surface unless the event or onOpenChange is canceled. ```tsx expanded content ``` ### Anchored surface Give Positioner a bounded width and height. anchor accepts center, top-start, top-end, bottom-start, and bottom-end. Logical edges respect RTL. Position this container with ordinary relative, absolute, or fixed layout; the panel is clamped to its bounds. ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { CheckIcon, FileTextIcon, FolderOpenIcon, LayoutGridIcon, PlusIcon, SaveIcon, Settings2Icon, XIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { useId, useState } from "react"; import type { OpenChangeEventDetails } from "@/components/control-ui/control-props"; import { cn } from "@/components/control-ui/lib/cn"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { MorphingPanel, MorphingPanelBody, MorphingPanelClose, MorphingPanelContent, MorphingPanelFooter, MorphingPanelHeader, MorphingPanelPositioner, MorphingPanelTrigger, } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/morphing-panel"; import { Slider } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/slider"; import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsPanel, TabsTab } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/tabs"; import { Textarea } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/textarea"; import { Heading, Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; const sections = { dimensions: { width: "360px", height: "304px" }, "aspect-ratio": { width: "360px", height: "268px" }, prompt: { width: "360px", height: "284px" }, } as const; type Section = keyof typeof sections; const ratios = [ { label: "1:1", value: 1 }, { label: "16:9", value: 16 / 9 }, { label: "21:9", value: 21 / 9 }, { label: "3:4", value: 3 / 4 }, { label: "4:3", value: 4 / 3 }, { label: "Custom", value: 7 / 5 }, ] as const; export function PrimitiveMorphingPanelExample() { const titleId = useId(); const [open, setOpen] = useState(false); const [section, setSection] = useState
